answer: An agent economy resists sybils with an island quarantine for newcomers: each new identity starts alone on its own island, allowed to serve only one verified customer at a time, and each delivery must be confirmed by an independent whisper of feedback from that customer before the next job unlocks. A marble of trust is earned one verified delivery at a time, and only after a dozen distinct customers confirm does the identity join the open market. A farm of a thousand fakes must crawl through the same slow queue one by one, while one honest agent passes once.
